blocks.explanation:
Yeh Case IV ka sawal hai: \((x^2 + 2)^2\) repeated irreducible quadratic aur \(x - 2\) linear factor.
Is mein paanch constants hain, is liye kaam lamba hai lekin mushkil nahi; bas tarteeb se chalna hai.
Find kya karna hai? \(A, B, C, D, E\).
Plan: \(x = 2\) se \(A\), phir upar wali power se shuru kar ke ek ek coefficient compare, constant se parakh, aur aakhir mein wapas jor kar tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{2x - 5}{(x^2 + 2)^2(x - 2)}\).
Humein find karna hai: is ki partial fractions.
Tareeqa: Top ki degree 1 aur bottom ki \(4 + 1 = 5\), is liye proper hai. \(x^2 + 2 = 0\) ka matlab \(x^2 = -2\), jo real number ke liye mumkin nahi, is liye \(x^2 + 2\) irreducible hai, aur yeh do dafa (square) aaya hai: yeh Case IV hai, bilkul book ki Example 8 jaisa. \(x = 2\) rakh kar \(A\), phir \(x^4, x^3, x^2, x\) ke coefficients compare kar ke \(B, C, D, E\) nikalenge.

Partial fractions ki shakal likhein
\[\dfrac{2x - 5}{(x^2 + 2)^2(x - 2)}\]
\[= \dfrac{A}{x - 2} + \dfrac{Bx + C}{x^2 + 2}\]
\[+ \dfrac{Dx + E}{(x^2 + 2)^2}\]
Kyun: \((x^2 + 2)^2\) repeated irreducible quadratic hai, is liye is ki har power ke liye alag fraction: \(\frac{Bx + C}{x^2 + 2}\) aur \(\frac{Dx + E}{(x^2 + 2)^2}\). Dono ke upar linear numerator aata hai. Linear factor \(x - 2\) ke upar sirf \(A\).
Dhyan dein: sirf \(\frac{Dx + E}{(x^2 + 2)^2}\) likh kar \(\frac{Bx + C}{x^2 + 2}\) chhor dena aam ghalti hai.

Denominators hata kar identity banayein
\[2x - 5 = A(x^2 + 2)^2\]
\[+ (Bx + C)(x^2 + 2)(x - 2)\]
\[+ (Dx + E)(x - 2) \quad \text{(i)}\]
Kyun: Dono taraf \((x^2 + 2)^2(x - 2)\) se multiply kiya. \(A\) ke saath \((x^2 + 2)^2\) bacha; \(Bx + C\) ke neeche sirf ek \((x^2 + 2)\) tha, is liye ek \((x^2 + 2)\) aur \((x - 2)\) bache; \(Dx + E\) ke saath sirf \((x - 2)\) bacha.

\(A\) ke liye (i) mein \(x = 2\) rakhein
\[4 - 5 = A(4 + 2)^2 + 0 + 0\]
\[-1 = 36A\]
\[A = -\dfrac{1}{36}\]
Kyun: \(x = 2\) rakhne se \(x - 2 = 0\), aur jin terms mein \((x - 2)\) hai woh sab zero. Sirf \(A(x^2 + 2)^2 = 36A\) bacha. Baqi chaar constants ke liye coefficients compare karne honge.

(i) ka har hissa kholein
\[A(x^2 + 2)^2 = Ax^4 + 4Ax^2 + 4A\]
\[(x^2 + 2)(x - 2)\]
\[= x^3 - 2x^2 + 2x - 4\]
\[(Bx + C)(x^3 - 2x^2 + 2x - 4)\]
\[= Bx^4 + (C - 2B)x^3\]
\[+ (2B - 2C)x^2 + (2C - 4B)x - 4C\]
\[(Dx + E)(x - 2)\]
\[= Dx^2 + (E - 2D)x - 2E\]
Kyun: Pehle \((x^2 + 2)(x - 2)\) ko alag multiply kiya taake kaam chhota rahe, phir use \((Bx + C)\) se. Har power ke terms saath saath likhe, taake agle qadam mein ikatthe karna aasaan ho.
Dhyan dein: \(C \times (-4) = -4C\) aur \(E \times (-2) = -2E\); constants ke signs sab se zyada ghalat hote hain.

Powers ke hisaab se ikattha karein
\[x^4:\ A + B\]
\[x^3:\ C - 2B\]
\[x^2:\ 4A + 2B - 2C + D\]
\[x:\ -4B + 2C - 2D + E\]
\[\text{const}:\ 4A - 4C - 2E\]
Kyun: Teeno hisson ke terms jama kar ke har power ka coefficient likha. Left side \(2x - 5\) mein \(x^4\), \(x^3\), \(x^2\) nahi hain (yani 0), \(x\) ka coefficient 2 aur constant \(-5\) hai.

\(x^4\) aur \(x^3\) ke coefficients compare karein
\[0 = A + B\]
\[B = -A = \dfrac{1}{36}\]
\[0 = C - 2B\]
\[C = 2B = \dfrac{2}{36} = \dfrac{1}{18}\]
Kyun: Left side par \(x^4\) aur \(x^3\) nahi, is liye dono coefficients 0. Pehli equation se \(B\), phir doosri se \(C\) mila. Fractions ko 36 ke denominator par rakhein to aagay hisaab aasaan hoga.

\(x^2\) ke coefficients compare karein
\[0 = 4A + 2B - 2C + D\]
\[D = -4A - 2B + 2C\]
\[= \dfrac{4}{36} - \dfrac{2}{36} + \dfrac{4}{36}\]
\[= \dfrac{6}{36} = \dfrac{1}{6}\]
Kyun: Left par \(x^2\) nahi, is liye coefficient 0. \(D\) ke ilawa sab doosri taraf le gaye aur values rakhin. \(-4A = +\frac{4}{36}\) kyunke \(A\) negative hai; yahan sign par khaas dhyan dein.

\(x\) ke coefficients compare karein
\[2 = -4B + 2C - 2D + E\]
\[E = 2 + 4B - 2C + 2D\]
\[= 2 + \dfrac{4}{36} - \dfrac{4}{36} + \dfrac{1}{3}\]
\[= \dfrac{7}{3}\]
Kyun: Left side par \(x\) ka coefficient 2 hai. \(E\) ko akela chhor kar baqi sab doosri taraf le gaye. \(4B\) aur \(2C\) dono \(\frac{4}{36}\) hain aur ek doosre ko cancel kar dete hain; \(2D = \frac{2}{6} = \frac{1}{3}\).

Constants se parakh
\[4A - 4C - 2E\]
\[= -\dfrac{4}{36} - \dfrac{8}{36} - \dfrac{14}{3}\]
\[= -\dfrac{1}{3} - \dfrac{14}{3} = -5 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Constant wali equation humne istemal nahi ki thi. Values rakhne par \(-5\) aaya, jo left side ka constant hai. Paanchon constants sahi hain.

Partial fractions likhein
\[Bx + C = \dfrac{x}{36} + \dfrac{2}{36} = \dfrac{x + 2}{36}\]
\[Dx + E = \dfrac{x}{6} + \dfrac{14}{6} = \dfrac{x + 14}{6}\]
Kyun: \(B\) aur \(C\) dono ka denominator 36 hai, is liye \(\frac{x + 2}{36}\). \(E = \frac{7}{3}\) ko \(\frac{14}{6}\) likha taake \(D\) ke saath common denominator 6 ho jaye: \(\frac{x + 14}{6}\). Phir yeh 36 aur 6 neeche chale jate hain.

Tasdeeq: fractions ko wapas jorein
Common denominator \(36(x^2 + 2)^2(x - 2)\); top:
\[-(x^2 + 2)^2 = -x^4 - 4x^2 - 4\]
\[(x + 2)(x - 2)(x^2 + 2)\]
\[= x^4 - 2x^2 - 8\]
\[6(x + 14)(x - 2)\]
\[= 6x^2 + 72x - 168\]
\[\text{Top} = 72x - 180\]
\[= 36(2x - 5) \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Common denominator \(36(x^2 + 2)^2(x - 2)\) liya. Pehla fraction \(-\frac{1}{36(x - 2)}\) apne top ko \((x^2 + 2)^2\) se, doosra \((x - 2)(x^2 + 2)\) se, aur teesra \(6(x - 2)\) se multiply karta hai. Teeno jorne par \(x^4\) aur \(x^2\) cancel ho gaye aur \(36(2x - 5)\) bacha. 36 cancel kar ke asal fraction wapas mil gaya.
blocks.final_answer:
\(\frac{2x - 5}{(x^2 + 2)^2(x - 2)} = -\frac{1}{36(x - 2)} + \frac{x + 2}{36(x^2 + 2)} + \frac{x + 14}{6(x^2 + 2)^2}\)
Yeh book ke jawab se milta hai, lekin key mein yeh doosre "3" ke number par chhapa hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki answer key mein yeh jawab "5" ke bajaye doosri dafa "3" ke number par chhapa hai (key ke numbers 1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 3 hain). Jawab khud sahi hai: \(\frac{-1}{36(x - 2)} + \frac{x + 2}{36(x^2 + 2)} + \frac{x + 14}{6(x^2 + 2)^2}\).
